name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with your feet planted and take a full overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades against the bench, brace your trunk and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your mid-to-lower chest with your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Drive the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders until your arms extend fully.
tips: Keep your upper back and glutes anchored to the bench with your wrists stacked directly over your elbows.
Touch your chest under control without bouncing the bar upward.
